mapper.select: select ri.id, ri.room_number, ri.rent, ai.id apartment_id, ai.name apartment_name, ai.introduction, ai.district_id, ai.district_name, ai.city_id, ai.city_name, ai.province_id, ai.province_name, ai.address_detail, ai.latitude, ai.longitude, ai.phone, ai.is_release from room_info ri left join apartment_info ai on ri.apartment_id = ai.id and ai.is_deleted = 0 where ri.is_deleted = 0 and ri.is_release = 1 and ri.apartment_id = #{apartmentId} order by ri.rent asc
